title: Mobile application crashes when transitioning to Network mode
description: The mobile application crashes immediately upon attempting to switch to 'Network Mode' from the 'Luxor System Control' screen.
steps: Enter valid email and password into the respective fields.
Tap the 'GO TO MY SITES' button.
Tap on any available site from the 'SITE LIST' (e.g., '3I Atlas').
Observe the application enters the site control screen.
Navigate back to the 'Luxor System Control' screen.
Tap the 'Return to Network Mode' button.
actual: The application crashes and closes unexpectedly when the 'Return to Network Mode' button is tapped.
expected: The application should transition to 'Network Mode' without crashing.
